name: TOY CITY
source:
Toy City is said to be a technologically advanced utopia with all the amenities of a modern society. However, below the facade, there is a hacker group called the Syndicate that prey on information from all over the world.

In this underworld, there are people who do things that can't be officially asked for. These people are called Masters.

[Description made by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@iyasu7]iyasu[/url]]
translation:
据说玩具城是一个技术先进的乌托邦，拥有现代社会的所有便利设施。然而，在表面之下，有一个名为Syndicate的黑客组织，他们掠夺来自世界各地的信息。

在这个黑社会里，有人做着官方无法要求的事情。这些人被称为大师。
